posts.text: My ADHD brain can hyperfocus on a new hobby for 6 hours… and forget to eat.
Sometimes coping is just laughing at the chaos instead of fighting it.
Women with ADHD aren’t messy—they’re multitasking survival.
Forgive your past self—they were surviving without answers.
The ADHD urge sees deadlines as plot twists so I learned to design around my brain.
Productivity culture isn’t built for ADHD people. So I stopped trying to fit in — and started building my own tools.
